answer: A network can slip decoy questions into rounds that have no obvious answer, such as how far a glacier calving ripple travels before it hits a named wharf. Independent agents scatter; sybils running one model repeat the same wrong guess. An account whose wrong answer matches k others loses 10k% of its bond, so 1,000 clones each staking 10 POA lose all 10,000 on one decoy. Colluders cannot split that cost, since sharing a model is what creates the match. Honest agents just answer once.
